description: Hand-written semantic source for FIELD-CATALOG.md. Keys are '<schema path>[/<array or map property>]#<property>'. Payload fields take meaning and F# type from FIELD-MAPPING.md. generate_catalogs.py fails if any schema property lacks an entry.

actor.schema.json#actorId.default: Copied from the producing command's actor.

actor.schema.json#kind.fsharp: Actor.Kind : ActorKind (Human | System | Agent of provider * model)
actor.schema.json#kind.meaning: Actor kind. "agent" actors MAY appear only on ProposalRecorded events (D-004).
actor.schema.json#kind.default: Copied from the producing command's actor.
actor.schema.json#kind.rule: human/system variant has exactly {actorId, kind}; agent variant has exactly {actorId, kind, provider, model}.

actor.schema.json#model.meaning: AI model of an agent actor.
actor.schema.json#model.rule: Non-blank text; present only when kind = "agent".

actor.schema.json#provider.meaning: AI provider of an agent actor.
actor.schema.json#provider.rule: Non-blank text; present only when kind = "agent".

entities/action.schema.json#id.meaning: Entity id; equals ActionRecorded.actionId of the event that created it.
entities/action.schema.json#id.rule: Unique within its entity array; arrays are sorted by id using ordinal comparison of the UUID text.

entities/action.schema.json#provenance.meaning: Who created the entity and when: the actor and occurredAt of the event that created it. Never changed by later events (CONTRACT §8.3).
entities/action.schema.json#provenance.default: Set once on creation from the creating event's actor and occurredAt.

entities/action.schema.json#targetHypoth.meaning: Hypotheses the action tests, in citation order.

entities/assumption.schema.json#id.meaning: Entity id; equals AssumptionRecorded.assumptionId of the event that created it.
entities/assumption.schema.json#id.rule: Unique within its entity array; arrays are sorted by id using ordinal comparison of the UUID text.

entities/assumption.schema.json#provenan.meaning: Who created the entity and when: the actor and occurredAt of the event that created it. Never changed by later events (CONTRACT §8.3).
entities/assumption.schema.json#provenan.default: Set once on creation from the creating event's actor and occurredAt.

entities/causal-member.schema.json#role.meaning: Role the hypothesis plays in the cause.

entities/cause.schema.json#id.meaning: Entity id; equals CausalAssertionRecorded.causeId of the event that created it.
entities/cause.schema.json#id.rule: Unique within its entity array; arrays are sorted by id using ordinal comparison of the UUID text.

entities/cause.schema.json#members.meaning: Hypotheses composing the cause, with roles, in recorded order.

entities/cause.schema.json#provenance.meaning: Who created the entity and when: the actor and occurredAt of the event that created it. Never changed by later events (CONTRACT §8.3).
entities/cause.schema.json#provenance.default: Set once on creation from the creating event's actor and occurredAt.

entities/cause.schema.json#state.default: "proposed" on creation; "confirmed" on CausalAssertionConfirmed; "reopened" on CausalAssertionReopened.

entities/conclusion.schema.json#causeIds.meaning: Causes the conclusion rests on, in citation order.

entities/conclusion.schema.json#id.meaning: Entity id; equals ConclusionRecorded.conclusionId of the event that created it.
entities/conclusion.schema.json#id.rule: Unique within its entity array; arrays are sorted by id using ordinal comparison of the UUID text.

entities/conclusion.schema.json#provenan.meaning: Who created the entity and when: the actor and occurredAt of the event that created it. Never changed by later events (CONTRACT §8.3).
entities/conclusion.schema.json#provenan.default: Set once on creation from the creating event's actor and occurredAt.

entities/conclusion.schema.json#recorded.meaning: aggregateVersion of the ConclusionRecorded event; the current conclusion is the one with the highest value.
entities/conclusion.schema.json#recorded.default: The aggregateVersion of the recording event.

entities/contradiction.schema.json#basis.default: null on creation; set by ContradictionTransitioned.basis.

entities/contradiction.schema.json#id.meaning: Entity id; equals ContradictionRecorded.contradictionId of the event that created it.
entities/contradiction.schema.json#id.rule: Unique within its entity array; arrays are sorted by id using ordinal comparison of the UUID text.

entities/contradiction.schema.json#mater.meaning: How much the contradiction matters; blocking contradictions block cause confirmation.

entities/contradiction.schema.json#prove.meaning: Who created the entity and when: the actor and occurredAt of the event that created it. Never changed by later events (CONTRACT §8.3).
entities/contradiction.schema.json#prove.default: Set once on creation from the creating event's actor and occurredAt.

entities/corrective-action.schema.json#a.meaning: aggregateVersion at which the current verification round began; 0 = never awaited verification. Used by verification freshness.
entities/corrective-action.schema.json#a.default: 0 on creation; set to the event's aggregateVersion when CorrectiveActionTransitioned.state = awaitingVerificationOfEffect.

entities/corrective-action.schema.json#i.meaning: Entity id; equals CorrectiveActionRecorded.correctiveActionId of the event that created it.
entities/corrective-action.schema.json#i.rule: Unique within its entity array; arrays are sorted by id using ordinal comparison of the UUID text.

entities/corrective-action.schema.json#p.meaning: Who created the entity and when: the actor and occurredAt of the event that created it. Never changed by later events (CONTRACT §8.3).
entities/corrective-action.schema.json#p.default: Set once on creation from the creating event's actor and occurredAt.

entities/corrective-action.schema.json#t.meaning: Causes the action addresses, in citation order.

entities/criterion.schema.json#id.meaning: Entity id; equals CriterionRecorded.criterionId of the event that created it.
entities/criterion.schema.json#id.rule: Unique within its entity array; arrays are sorted by id using ordinal comparison of the UUID text.

entities/criterion.schema.json#method.meaning: How it will be checked, if stated.

entities/criterion.schema.json#provenanc.meaning: Who created the entity and when: the actor and occurredAt of the event that created it. Never changed by later events (CONTRACT §8.3).
entities/criterion.schema.json#provenanc.default: Set once on creation from the creating event's actor and occurredAt.

entities/evidence.schema.json#admittedAt.meaning: aggregateVersion of the EvidenceAdmitted event; used for 'new evidence' and verification-freshness rules.
entities/evidence.schema.json#admittedAt.default: The aggregateVersion of the admitting event.

entities/evidence.schema.json#capturedAt.meaning: When the evidence was captured, if known.

entities/evidence.schema.json#content.fsharp: Evidence.Content : EvidenceContent (payload NonEmptyText or uri string)
entities/evidence.schema.json#content.meaning: Evidence text verbatim, or the absolute http(s) URL of the artifact (R3.5).

entities/evidence.schema.json#contentKin.meaning: Whether content is verbatim text or an artifact URL.

entities/evidence.schema.json#id.meaning: Entity id; equals EvidenceAdmitted.evidenceId of the event that created it.
entities/evidence.schema.json#id.rule: Unique within its entity array; arrays are sorted by id using ordinal comparison of the UUID text.

entities/evidence.schema.json#provenance.meaning: Who created the entity and when: the actor and occurredAt of the event that created it. Never changed by later events (CONTRACT §8.3).
entities/evidence.schema.json#provenance.default: Set once on creation from the creating event's actor and occurredAt.

entities/evidence.schema.json#superseded.meaning: Replacement evidence, if this evidence was superseded. The original stays in history.
entities/evidence.schema.json#superseded.default: null on admission; set by EvidenceSuperseded.replacementEvidenceId.

entities/finding.schema.json#id.meaning: Entity id; equals FindingRecorded.findingId of the event that created it.
entities/finding.schema.json#id.rule: Unique within its entity array; arrays are sorted by id using ordinal comparison of the UUID text.

entities/finding.schema.json#interpretat.meaning: Interpretation of the result, if any.

entities/finding.schema.json#provenance.meaning: Who created the entity and when: the actor and occurredAt of the event that created it. Never changed by later events (CONTRACT §8.3).
entities/finding.schema.json#provenance.default: Set once on creation from the creating event's actor and occurredAt.

entities/hypothesis-change.schema.json#a.meaning: Event sequence of the change; used by 'new evidence since falsification' rules.
entities/hypothesis-change.schema.json#a.default: The aggregateVersion of the HypothesisTransitioned event (CONTRACT §7.2).
The occurredAt of the HypothesisTransitioned event (not persisted in the payload; CONTRACT §7.2).

entities/hypothesis-change.schema.json#e.meaning: Evidence cited for the change, in citation order.

entities/hypothesis.schema.json#history.meaning: Every hypothesis transition in aggregateVersion order (R2.3).
entities/hypothesis.schema.json#history.default: [] on creation; HypothesisTransitioned appends one entry.

entities/hypothesis.schema.json#id.meaning: Entity id; equals HypothesisRecorded.hypothesisId of the event that created it.
entities/hypothesis.schema.json#id.rule: Unique within its entity array; arrays are sorted by id using ordinal comparison of the UUID text.

entities/hypothesis.schema.json#provenan.meaning: Who created the entity and when: the actor and occurredAt of the event that created it. Never changed by later events (CONTRACT §8.3).
entities/hypothesis.schema.json#provenan.default: Set once on creation from the creating event's actor and occurredAt.

entities/hypothesis.schema.json#state.default: "proposed" on creation; set to HypothesisTransitioned.to on each transition.

entities/negative-knowledge.schema.json#.meaning: Evidence establishing it, at least one, in citation order.
Entity id; equals NegativeKnowledgeEstablished.negativeKnowledgeId of the event that created it.
entities/negative-knowledge.schema.json#.rule: Unique within its entity array; arrays are sorted by id using ordinal comparison of the UUID text.

entities/negative-knowledge.schema.json#.meaning: Who created the entity and when: the actor and occurredAt of the event that created it. Never changed by later events (CONTRACT §8.3).
entities/negative-knowledge.schema.json#.default: Set once on creation from the creating event's actor and occurredAt.

entities/negative-knowledge.schema.json#.meaning: Scope within which the negative statement holds.
What was established NOT to be the case (R5.3).

entities/observation.schema.json#id.meaning: Entity id; equals InvestigationStarted/ObservationRecorded.observationId of the event that created it.
entities/observation.schema.json#id.rule: Unique within its entity array; arrays are sorted by id using ordinal comparison of the UUID text.

entities/observation.schema.json#observe.meaning: When the observation was made, if known. Always null for the initial observation created by InvestigationStarted.
entities/observation.schema.json#observe.default: null for the InvestigationStarted observation; otherwise copied from ObservationRecorded.observedAt.

entities/observation.schema.json#provena.meaning: Who created the entity and when: the actor and occurredAt of the event that created it. Never changed by later events (CONTRACT §8.3).
entities/observation.schema.json#provena.default: Set once on creation from the creating event's actor and occurredAt.

entities/prediction.schema.json#id.meaning: Entity id; equals PredictionRecorded.predictionId of the event that created it.
entities/prediction.schema.json#id.rule: Unique within its entity array; arrays are sorted by id using ordinal comparison of the UUID text.

entities/prediction.schema.json#provenan.meaning: Who created the entity and when: the actor and occurredAt of the event that created it. Never changed by later events (CONTRACT §8.3).
entities/prediction.schema.json#provenan.default: Set once on creation from the creating event's actor and occurredAt.

entities/prediction.schema.json#strength.meaning: How strongly the prediction follows from the hypothesis.

entities/prediction.schema.json#timing.meaning: Prospective or retrospective, as decided by the engine.

entities/proposal.schema.json#decision.meaning: Rejection reason when rejected; otherwise null.
entities/proposal.schema.json#decision.default: null on creation; set to ProposalWasRejected.reason.

entities/proposal.schema.json#id.meaning: Entity id; equals ProposalRecorded.proposalId of the event that created it.
entities/proposal.schema.json#id.rule: Unique within its entity array; arrays are sorted by id using ordinal comparison of the UUID text.

entities/proposal.schema.json#kind.meaning: What the proposal would create if accepted.

entities/proposal.schema.json#provenance.meaning: Who created the entity and when: the actor and occurredAt of the event that created it. Never changed by later events (CONTRACT §8.3).
entities/proposal.schema.json#provenance.default: Set once on creation from the creating event's actor and occurredAt.

entities/proposal.schema.json#rationale.meaning: Why it was proposed, if stated.

entities/proposal.schema.json#state.default: "active" on creation; "accepted" on ProposalWasAccepted; "rejected" on ProposalWasRejected.

entities/proposal.schema.json#text.meaning: Proposed statement, question or purpose; never evidence (R15.2).

entities/relationship.schema.json#id.meaning: Entity id; equals EvidenceRelated.relationshipId of the event that created it.
entities/relationship.schema.json#id.rule: Unique within its entity array; arrays are sorted by id using ordinal comparison of the UUID text.

entities/relationship.schema.json#kind.meaning: How the evidence bears on the hypothesis.

entities/relationship.schema.json#proven.meaning: Who created the entity and when: the actor and occurredAt of the event that created it. Never changed by later events (CONTRACT §8.3).
entities/relationship.schema.json#proven.default: Set once on creation from the creating event's actor and occurredAt.

entities/relationship.schema.json#ration.meaning: Why the relationship holds, if stated.

entities/unknown.schema.json#basis.default: null on creation; set by UnknownTransitioned.basis.

entities/unknown.schema.json#id.meaning: Entity id; equals UnknownIdentified.unknownId of the event that created it.
entities/unknown.schema.json#id.rule: Unique within its entity array; arrays are sorted by id using ordinal comparison of the UUID text.

entities/unknown.schema.json#materiality.meaning: How much the unknown matters to the conclusion.

entities/unknown.schema.json#provenance.meaning: Who created the entity and when: the actor and occurredAt of the event that created it. Never changed by later events (CONTRACT §8.3).
entities/unknown.schema.json#provenance.default: Set once on creation from the creating event's actor and occurredAt.

entities/verification.schema.json#eviden.meaning: Evidence cited, in citation order; non-empty when satisfied (R7.4).

entities/verification.schema.json#id.meaning: Entity id; equals VerificationRecorded.verificationId of the event that created it.
entities/verification.schema.json#id.rule: Unique within its entity array; arrays are sorted by id using ordinal comparison of the UUID text.

entities/verification.schema.json#proven.meaning: Who created the entity and when: the actor and occurredAt of the event that created it. Never changed by later events (CONTRACT §8.3).
entities/verification.schema.json#proven.default: Set once on creation from the creating event's actor and occurredAt.

entities/verification.schema.json#record.meaning: aggregateVersion of the VerificationRecorded event (verification freshness, R7.4).
entities/verification.schema.json#record.default: The aggregateVersion of the recording event.

event-envelope.schema.json#actor.meaning: Actor who issued the producing command.
event-envelope.schema.json#actor.rule: See actor.schema.json; agent only on ProposalRecorded.

event-envelope.schema.json#aggregateVers.meaning: Position in the history; 1..N in file order.
event-envelope.schema.json#aggregateVers.default: Next version after the current one.
event-envelope.schema.json#aggregateVers.rule: Exactly 1..N in file order (CAUSA.SEQUENCE_INVALID); InvestigationStarted is version 1.

event-envelope.schema.json#correlationId.meaning: Id of the producing command; shared by all events of one command group.
event-envelope.schema.json#correlationId.rule: Must not name two non-adjacent groups (CAUSA.CORRELATION_REUSED).

event-envelope.schema.json#eventId.fsharp: derived Guid (engine has no event id)
event-envelope.schema.json#eventId.rule: Must equal the derivation (CAUSA.EVENT_ID_MISMATCH) and be unique (CAUSA.EVENT_ID_DUPLICATE).

event-envelope.schema.json#eventType.meaning: Event discriminator selecting the payload schema.

event-envelope.schema.json#formatVersion.rule: A string other than "1.0.0" is CAUSA.UNSUPPORTED_VERSION (stage 5); non-string is CAUSA.SCHEMA_VIOLATION.

event-envelope.schema.json#investigation.rule: Must equal the manifest investigationId and directory name (CAUSA.INVESTIGATION_MISMATCH).

event-envelope.schema.json#occurredAt.meaning: Time the producing command was decided (engine RequestedAt), millisecond UTC.
event-envelope.schema.json#occurredAt.default: Supplied by the command boundary, millisecond-truncated.
event-envelope.schema.json#occurredAt.rule: Recorded, not validated for order; calendar-valid; sub-millisecond instants are CAUSA.UNREPRESENTABLE on write.

event-envelope.schema.json#payload.meaning: Event-specific data; shape selected by eventType.

event-envelope.schema.json#semanticVersi.rule: A string other than "1.0.0" is CAUSA.UNSUPPORTED_VERSION.

golden-scenarios.schema.json#scenarios.meaning: Informative generator summary per scenario (not authoritative).

golden-scenarios.schema.json/scenarios#c.meaning: Commands issued: persisted command groups plus refused commands.

golden-scenarios.schema.json/scenarios/r.meaning: Every code the engine returned, joined by '; '.
Domain code the engine must return first.
0-based generator step index of the refused command.

investigation-manifest.schema.json#aggre.rule: Must equal the number of lines (stage 8, CAUSA.MANIFEST_MISMATCH).

investigation-manifest.schema.json#domai.meaning: Domain packs applied; none exist in v1.0.0.

investigation-manifest.schema.json#event.rule: Must equal the number of lines (CAUSA.MANIFEST_MISMATCH).

investigation-manifest.schema.json#event.meaning: SHA-256 of the exact events.ndjson bytes.

investigation-manifest.schema.json#snaps.meaning: SHA-256 of the canonical snapshot text without its trailing LF.

negative-fixture.schema.json#appendedEve.meaning: NDJSON lines to append, base64 (kind append).

negative-fixture.schema.json#baseScenari.meaning: Frozen scenario the append/successor applies to.

negative-fixture.schema.json#directoryId.meaning: Directory name under which the files are validated (kind investigation).

negative-fixture.schema.json#expectedAgg.meaning: Version the append command observed (kind append).

negative-fixture.schema.json#expectedDom.meaning: Domain code for CAUSA.HISTORY_INADMISSIBLE; otherwise null.

negative-fixture.schema.json#expectedErr.meaning: Primary code a conforming reader must report.

negative-fixture.schema.json#files.meaning: Directory entries by file name, base64 bytes (kind investigation or successor).

negative-fixture.schema.json#name.meaning: Fixture name; equals the file stem.

negative-fixture.schema.json/files#{file.meaning: One directory entry; the key is the exact file name (any name, so missing and extra files are representable, CONTRACT §3.3).

root-manifest.schema.json#investigations.meaning: Valid investigations, ordered by investigationId (ordinal), unique ids and keys.

root-manifest.schema.json#negativeFixtur.meaning: Negative fixtures with their expected primary code.

root-manifest.schema.json#schemaSha256.meaning: Schema identity: SHA-256 of schemas/bundle.json bytes.

root-manifest.schema.json/investigations.rule: Any difference from the investigation is CAUSA.FIXTURE_DRIFT.
Any difference from the investigation is CAUSA.FIXTURE_DRIFT.

root-manifest.schema.json/investigations.meaning: Digest of the canonical state object (§8.4).
root-manifest.schema.json/investigations.rule: Any difference from the investigation is CAUSA.FIXTURE_DRIFT.
Any difference from the investigation is CAUSA.FIXTURE_DRIFT.
Any difference from the investigation is CAUSA.FIXTURE_DRIFT.

Any difference from the investigation is CAUSA.FIXTURE_DRIFT.
Any difference from the investigation is CAUSA.FIXTURE_DRIFT.
Any difference from the investigation is CAUSA.FIXTURE_DRIFT.

root-manifest.schema.json/negativeFixtur.meaning: Primary code a conforming reader must report.
root-manifest.schema.json/negativeFixtur.rule: Must equal the fixture's own expectedErrorCode.

root-manifest.schema.json/negativeFixtur.meaning: Path of the negative fixture relative to fixtures/v1.0.0/.

schema-bundle.schema.json#canonicalizati.meaning: Canonical JSON form used by data files.

schema-bundle.schema.json#schemas.meaning: Every *.schema.json under schemas/, sorted ordinally by path.

schema-bundle.schema.json/schemas#sha256.meaning: SHA-256 of the schema file's exact bytes.

snapshot.schema.json#aggregateVersion.meaning: Version of the last applied event.

snapshot.schema.json#generatedAt.meaning: occurredAt of event aggregateVersion (deterministic; not wall-clock).
snapshot.schema.json#generatedAt.rule: Snapshot must be byte-identical to the replayed projection (CAUSA.SNAPSHOT_MISMATCH).

state.schema.json#actions.meaning: All InvestigationAction entities, sorted by id (ordinal UUID text).
state.schema.json#actions.default: [] on InvestigationStarted; entries created by ActionRecorded.
state.schema.json#actions.rule: Sorted by id ordinally; ids unique.
